name: Permits & Licensing Committee Special Meeting
minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  SPECIAL MEETING
  MINUTES
  August 7, 2025

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1-669-900-6833,
meeting ID: 879 2164 0389 and Password 892426 on August 7, 2025 at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh- Administration
  Christine Rivera - Planning Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson - Los Angeles County Fire Department
  Sgt.Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department

  Staff Present:  Aisha Thompson, City Clerk’s Department
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department
  Sy’Naelyn Thomas, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items

During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the
item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits &
License Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on July 24, 2025

Permit(s):

Item #1:  Cinder Eller Kimbell on behalf of Inglewood Police Department to host an Inglewood
  Police Department National Night Out 2025 Event at Grevillea Ave, between Queen
  St and Regent St; Public Property; on Tuesday, August 12, 2025 from 5:00 p.m. -
  8:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY; Approval for 1 day event on Grevillea
  Avenue between Regent Street and Queen Street; Subject to Public Works approval
  for use/closure of the right-of-way; Two (2) Police Officers & Five (5) TCO's will be
  present for public safety and street closures; WC has been notified; Applicant will
  coordinate Meridian traffic barrier deployment with the Public Works Department;
  None Code Enforcemnent Condtions; None additional recommendations for Fire
  approval; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at
  the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all
  social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety
  guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health
   department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage.Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00406263)

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits &
License Committee on any matters connected with items on the Agenda, it was reported that there
were no public requests to speak.
